title: Tips for a "stand out" LinkedIn profile ✍️
description:
You need to stand out if you want to land an interview and the best way you can help your LinkedIn profile with this is having your work experience populated with the strongest elements of your career history. You can think of your LinkedIn work experience almost exactly like your resume work experience. This is not an area to relist responsibilities. This is where you want to show high value IMPACT. Show the recruiters looking at your LinkedIn profile you have value as an employee and can make a difference at their company. #linkedin #linkedintips #linkedinprofile #linkedinprofiletips
